subject: general
question: A can do 87.5% of the work in 35 days while B can do 65% of the same work in 23.4 days. If they work together, what fraction of the work will get done in 1 day?
solution:
**Given:**

A can do 87.5% of the work in 35 days

B can do 65% of the same work in 23.4 days.

**Concept used:**

If a person can complete a work alone in x days, then the efficiency (part of the work completed in one day) = 1/x

**Calculation:**

A can-do 87.5% of the work in 35 day

A can-do 1% of the work in (35/87.5) days

A can-do 100% of the work in (35/87.5) × 100 days

⇒ 40 days
